def combination_sum(cands, target):
    out = []
    def rec(i, cur, t):
        if t == 0:
            out.append(cur[:]); return
        for j in range(i, len(cands)):
            if cands[j] > t: break
            cur.append(cands[j])
            rec(j, cur, t - cands[j])
            cur.pop()
    rec(0, [], target)
    return out
```
